title: Cannot manually set wallpaper while the wallpaper selection window is open
line: Setting a wallpaper from Dolphin while the wallpaper settings are open now changes the desktop right away.
explanation: Clicking a thumbnail in the desktop settings only previews it: the image wallpaper shows PreviewImage instead of Image while it is set. Dolphin's Set as Wallpaper (plasma-apply-wallpaperimage) writes Image into the same live configuration, but the leftover PreviewImage kept hiding it until the dialog closed and cleared the preview. The image config page now watches the live Image value: when it changes from outside, it drops the preview and selects the new image, so the desktop switches at once and Apply/OK no longer bring back the old pick.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: follow a wallpaper set from outside the config dialog

While the desktop settings showed an unapplied pick, setting a wallpaper
from Dolphin or plasma-apply-wallpaperimage was hidden by the preview
until the dialog closed. Now the dialog drops its preview and selects it.

BUG: 506131

media.caption: After setting Autumn from outside (Dolphin's path), the desktop still shows Altai.
Setting Autumn from outside now switches the desktop and the dialog selects Autumn.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in wallpapers/image/config.qml that listens to wallpaperConfiguration.valueChanged for 'Image' in single-image mode, updates cfg_Image, and clears PreviewImage using the file's existing 'null' sentinel. This immediately shows wallpapers set externally via Dolphin or plasma-apply-wallpaperimage instead of keeping the unapplied preview on top, keeps Apply/Cancel state consistent, and does not interfere with Slideshow mode or the lock screen KCM. Evidence and verification are thorough and match the diff.

Right diagnosis and layer: PreviewImage is the image plugin's own preview mechanism, and Dolphin's Set as Wallpaper (evaluateScript writeConfig, which for wallpapers does setProperty on the live QQmlPropertyMap and so emits valueChanged for that key only) was hidden by it. Following the outside change in config.qml both clears the preview and moves cfg_Image, so the desktop switches at once and Apply/OK don't bring the old pick back; 'outside wins' matches the reporter's expected result. The handler also fires on the dialog's own Apply writes and on full KConfigPropertyMap reloads, but then it just sets cfg_Image to the value it already holds, so nothing breaks. The before-2/after-2 screenshots show the claimed change (pair 1 is only the setup step), and the commit text matches the 12-line patch.
